name: Mind Map Maker for Excel
description_en:
Mind Map Maker for Excel is a product in the Mind mapping category. Its directory profile covers Visual Mind Map, Search and Navigation Tools, Export to Document Formats, Collaboration Tools, Built-in Templates.

Deployment is listed as Desktop App (Windows). The listed organization sizes are Medium Business Small Business Freelancers Individuals. API support is listed as Not available. Support channels are listed as Business Hours.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $2.99.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: support shared work and communication between participants. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
